inlines.v: DISTURBER, noun 1. One who disturbs or disquiets; a violator of peace; one who causes tumults or disorders. 2. He or that which excites passion or agitation; he or that which causes perturbation. 3. In law, one that interrupts or incommodes another in the peaceable enjoyment of his right.
